The institution's official site is reachable at kwiu.edu.ge (confirmed via EQAR/education-directory cross-references) and serves its own logo and hero banner directly — no recruitment/social-media imagery used..

entries.reason: Faculty-level record (Medical Faculty of Khakas State University named after N.F. Katanov). No dedicated faculty logo/cover exists independently of the parent university; a decision is needed on whether this should inherit Khakas State University branding or be merged/retired as a catalogue entry before sourcing media.

Confirmed directly on Khalifa University's own brand page (ku.ac.ae/media/visual-identity-and-branding-guidelines) that logo/branding assets require contacting the Communications and Business Development Department — written permission is explicitly required, consistent with the original hold reason. A Commons file (File:Khalifa University New Logo.png) claims CC BY-SA 4.0, but it was self-declared "own work" by an unaffiliated Commons uploader (Rem1706) merely citing ku.ac.ae as the source — a common Commons mislabeling pattern for corporate trademarks, not a verifiable release by the rights holder — so it was not used. No written-permission workflow was pursued per instructions.

Second-pass upgrade (2026-07-26): Cover still held: the homepage's only large imagery is news-story thumbnails (diploma ceremonies, events), with no og:image or identifiable campus-exterior photo; no Commons/Wikidata image claim exists either. Logo resolved by going straight to the official Bitrix-CMS site rather than search-engine snippets.. Remaining outstanding: cover.
